issue_request: FHIR-14420 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocab change request for Terminology Module section 4.0.5. It reported that the Developmental Roadmap maturity levels differed from the Resource Index and asked to revise or remove the incorrect information.
initial_application: Jira records the change as pre-applied in SVN 13359. Git-svn commit 9c32d3b1c90a34bfad894cf6d2237409525b4a0b explicitly mentions GF#14420, GF#14541, and GF#15706 and changed source/terminology-module.html from stale hard-coded roadmap maturity values to the aligned STU3 values, including ValueSet 5, CodeSystem 5, ConceptMap 3, ExpansionProfile 2, and TerminologyCapabilities 0.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes terminology-module.html in the active build hierarchy, and source/fhir.ini has active terminology resource entries plus current FMM metadata. Later GF#13349 roadmap edits preserved the corrected maturity alignment. Later GF#16337 and GF#16490 removed ExpansionProfile from core, so its absence from the current module is intentional. FHIR-15706, the closest same-change-family maturity issue from the same SVN application, is already represented on the combined branch by a no-change audit commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/terminology-module.html and source/resourcelist.html both use fmmshort macros for terminology resources, so maturity display is no longer maintained as divergent hard-coded values on the Terminology Module page.
